_comment: Engraphy hook wiring for Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` block into
project), and replace <ENGRAPHY> with the path to your checkout.
SessionStart names the scope and states the pre-work contract. It fires
before any user message exists, so the hinted half of the briefing runs on
UserPromptSubmit instead, once per session, where the first request is
available to use as the hint.
The hooks inject context and make no network call, so they need no token
and cannot stall a session. Both exit 0 on every path; the timeouts are a
second guard, and a hook that exceeds one is killed with the session
